description: FUG shortcut column, saturated vapour feed of benzene, toluene and cumene; light key toluene (95 % to the distillate), heavy key cumene (98 % to the bottoms), R = 2.
source: tests/test_shortcut_column.py TextbookCaseTest: P. C. Wankat, Separation Process Engineering, 5th ed., Examples 7-1 and 7-2 print benzene 99.85 % to the distillate, distillate flows (39.94, 28.5, 0.60) per 100 of feed and (L/D)min = 0.6663; N_min = ln(19 * 49) / ln(1 / 0.21) = 4.3804 by hand. Tolerance half a unit in the last printed digit (5e-5 on N_min and the benzene fraction, 0.005 on the benzene flow), 1e-9 on the key flows, which follow from the specs exactly, and 0.1 % on (L/D)min (the book rounds its Underwood root).
